name: review-prompt
displayName: Review prompt (store rating ask + in-app feedback)
description: Store rating ask at happy moments behind an anti-spam ledger, iOS-optional rating gate, Play-compliant direct card on Android, and an in-app feedback path to Supabase.

notes: expo-store-review is a NATIVE module: dev clients and store builds must be rebuilt after installing. The lazy require in lib/review/index.ts is what keeps binaries built BEFORE this module from crashing at app start — do not convert it to a static import.
The gate sheet is iOS-only BY POLICY: Google Play prohibits any question before its rating flow. Read review-prompt-guidelines.md before changing the platform split in either direction.
The app owner must explicitly choose whether iOS uses the gate at all; no-gate (native sheet only) is the safer default.

placeholders.what: storeReviewUrl(): the iOS App Store id and Android package name
the app name in the sheet copy, the theme/analytics/version import paths
the env config import (Supabase URL + anon key) and app-version import
renumber into the app's migration sequence

postInstall: Wire requestReviewAsk('<trigger>') into 1-2 completed-task moments, after their celebration settles.
Add settings rows: rate (openStoreReviewPage), share feedback (RateSheet startAt=feedback), dev block (forceShowReviewSheet, resetReviewLedger).
Add the five events to the app's typed analytics union: Review Prompt Shown/Rated/Dismissed, Store Review Opened, Feedback Sent.
supabase db push the migration; supabase functions deploy app-feedback --no-verify-jwt; probe with a curl POST and an anon select (must return []).
Port the ledger + orchestrator + sheet tests from DailyBook (__tests__/reviewLedger.test.ts, reviewAsk.test.ts, reviewAskNoModule.test.ts, rateSheet.test.tsx).
